follow100Note: Of the $23.23 kept as profit per $100 of revenue, $23.35 accrued to Uber shareholders and non-controlling partners absorbed a $0.12 loss. Rows may not add exactly due to rounding.
footerNote: Net income of $2,599M is the total including non-controlling interests; $2,612M is attributable to Uber shareholders (the $1.20 EPS figure) because non-controlling partners absorbed a $13M loss.

kpis.label: EPS (GAAP)
kpis.note: vs $0.10 a year ago — flattered by the investment gain below

oneTimers: Net income includes a $1.7B pre-tax benefit from net unrealized gains on the revaluation of Uber's equity investments — a paper gain that could reverse if those stocks fall.
otherDetail: Other income, net of $1,851M — mostly a $1.7B pre-tax gain from revaluing Uber's equity investments — less $143M of interest expense and a $12M loss from equity method investments.

segments.name: Mobility
segments.note: Rides — the original Uber business. Gross Bookings rose 17% to $21.0B.

segments.name: Delivery
segments.note: Food and grocery delivery — Uber Eats and couriers. Gross Bookings rose 16% to $18.7B.

segments.name: Freight
segments.note: Trucking logistics — matching shippers with carriers. Revenue barely grew as freight markets stayed soft.

takeaways.text: Income from operations reached $1,061M — the first time Uber has cleared $1B in a quarter — up from $394M a year ago, as revenue growth outpaced costs. Adjusted EBITDA rose 55% to $1.7B.
takeaways.title: First billion-dollar operating profit

takeaways.text: Revenue rose 20% to $11.2B on 2.9 billion trips (+17%). Mobility revenue jumped 26% and Delivery 18%; Freight, still facing a soft trucking market, grew just 2%.
takeaways.title: Growth stayed broad

takeaways.text: Net income attributable to Uber was $2.6B, but $1.7B of it (pre-tax) was an unrealized gain from marking up the value of Uber's equity investments — not cash from rides or deliveries. Free cash flow was a more grounded $2.1B.
takeaways.title: A paper gain padded the bottom line

verdict: Uber passed $1B of quarterly operating profit for the first time as revenue grew 20% to $11.2B — and a $1.7B paper gain on its investments then lifted net income to $2.6B.
